title: Design System: SSU Informational Editorial Theme

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Removes hero, category, and content reveals when reduced motion is requested.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The ink-blue primary action used for valid tenant-supplied destinations and recovery.
components.css: .ds-editorial-action { min-height: 2.75rem; border: 1px solid #12263f; border-radius: 0.25rem; background: #12263f; color: #fff; padding: 0.75rem 1.25rem; font: 700 0.875rem/1.25 var(--font-body, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; } .ds-editorial-action:hover { background: #203c5b; } .ds-editorial-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary-700, #315f9a); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Running Head
components.description: A compact tenant, folio, and route context band.
components.css: .ds-running-head { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr; align-items: center; min-height: 2.5rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8c5d0; background: #f7f8f4; color: #526273; padding: 0 1.5rem; font: 700 0.6875rem/1.2 var(--font-body, sans-serif); letter-spacing: 0.11em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-running-head span:nth-child(2) { border-inline: 1px solid #b8c5d0; padding-inline: 1rem; } .ds-running-head span:last-child { text-align: right; }

components.name: Information Index
components.description: Visible tenant destinations in a horizontally resilient index.
components.css: .ds-info-index { display: flex; overflow-x: auto; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8c5d0; background: #fff; } .ds-info-index a { display: flex; min-height: 3.25rem; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; border-right: 1px solid #b8c5d0; color: #12263f; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; font: 650 0.8125rem/1.2 var(--font-body, sans-serif); text-decoration: none; } .ds-info-index small { color: #526273; font-size: 0.625rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-info-index a:hover, .ds-info-index a:focus-visible, .ds-info-index-active { background: #f8e7b4; } .ds-info-index a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary-700, #315f9a); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Long-form Article
components.description: A calm reading column with familiar document structures.
components.html:
Section heading

Published tenant information remains readable at a familiar measure.

A tenant-supplied quotation or note.
components.css: .ds-article { max-width: 72ch; background: #fff; color: #172431; padding: 2rem; font: 400 1.0625rem/1.85 var(--font-body, sans-serif); } .ds-article h2 { margin: 2.5rem 0 0.75rem; color: #12263f; font: 650 1.75rem/1.2 var(--font-heading, sans-serif); letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-article blockquote { margin: 1.5rem 0; border-left: 1px solid #12263f; background: #fbf3dc; color: #12263f; padding: 1rem 1.25rem; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A precise raised-paper field with a tenant-controlled focus accent.
components.css: .ds-editorial-field { min-height: 2.75rem; border: 1px solid #b8c5d0; border-radius: 0.25rem; background: #fff; color: #172431; caret-color: var(--color-primary-700, #315f9a); padding: 0.75rem 1rem; font: 400 1rem/1.5 var(--font-body, sans-serif); } .ds-editorial-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary-700, #315f9a); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-editorial-field::placeholder { color: #526273; }

narrative.overview: Informational Editorial is a distinct public storefront world within SSU. It makes an organisation's pages, articles, and structured information feel dependable and findable through an ink-blue frame, cool reading paper, indexed navigation, running heads, and calm text measures. The theme supplies visual organisation while the merchant supplies every topic, claim, author, image, and action. The frame commits strongly without competing with the reading column. Folio markers and saffron position bands help visitors understand where they are, while conventional links, hierarchy, article patterns, tables, and forms remain recognizable.
keyCharacteristics: Ink-blue information frame around cool reading paper.
Saffron position markers used with text and structure, never alone.
Indexed wayfinding and tabular folio numbers.
Reading columns constrained to roughly 72 characters.
Flat panels separated by rules, tone, and spacing rather than shadows.

rules.name: The Position Has Two Signals Rule
rules.body: Saffron may reinforce the current location, but a label, underline, route, or structural placement must communicate it independently.

rules.name: The Tenant Truth Rule
rules.body: Theme color and structure may organize supplied information; they never imply authority, authorship, publication history, or institutional proof the tenant did not provide.

rules.name: The Reading Column Rule
rules.body: World-building belongs to the masthead, navigation, rules, and openers; running text stays at a familiar size, contrast, and measure.

rules.name: The Merchant Type Rule
rules.body: Preserve configured heading and body families; do not impose a fixed magazine serif or technical monospace identity.

rules.name: The Flat Reference Rule
rules.body: A persistent informational surface uses a rule, tone, or spacing change instead of a box shadow.

dos: Do keep the reader's current location and next destinations visible.
Do constrain long-form content to a readable measure and preserve familiar document structures.
Do use real tenant navigation, articles, pages, images, metadata, and contact actions.
Do preserve keyboard focus, reduced motion, localization, and transaction behavior on every route.
donts: Don't turn the reading column into a poster, magazine cover, or decorative interface.
Don't use saffron or the merchant accent as the only indication of state.
Don't fabricate authors, publication dates, topics, statistics, institutional claims, media, or calls to action.
Don't move API, tenant, cart, checkout, form, SEO, localization, or module logic into the theme renderer.
